prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production monster sprite animation sheet for an existing 2D action RPG.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image1 is STYLE/LAYOUT reference ONLY: match its crisp finely detailed high-resolution pixel-illustrated fantasy sprites, dark ink outlines, 3/4 overhead RPG camera, shading and level of detail; never copy its subject. Image2 is SUBJECT CONCEPT reference only: pick the matching creature archetype from this encyclopedia for anatomy and costume ideas only. Produce a brand-new single-species sheet.
OUTPUT: genuinely transparent RGBA, no matte, no checkerboard, no background, no floor, no shadow oval. Square 2048x2048 or larger native pixels. Exactly 25 separate full-body monster silhouettes in a perfectly regular 5 columns x 5 rows invisible grid. Each cell same dimensions and clear padding; poses never touch each other or the canvas edge. No labels, text, frame borders, UI, grid lines, glow background, extra monsters or scenery.
DIRECTIONS by ROW top-to-bottom: row1 front facing screen/down (south); row2 front-right three-quarter (southeast); row3 right profile (east); row4 back-right three-quarter (northeast); row5 back facing screen/up (north). Actually turn anatomy, faces and bodies in each row; do not repeat the front view.
ACTIONS by COLUMN left-to-right: 1 walk A planted left foot; 2 walk B visibly alternating limbs; 3 attack windup; 4 attack contact with a distinct forward action; 5 dead body lying flat on the ground. Keep each direction's body scale unchanged across actions. Feet or grounded contact point aligned near the cell bottom; full anatomy, no clipping. This is ONE creature repeated 25 times for animation, not a monster catalog.
SUBJECT: An ice wyvern boss, pale blue scaled dragon with large membrane wings used as front legs, white frost spikes along the spine, long tail with ice blade tip, glowing blue eyes. Windup rears back with wings spread; contact lunges forward biting. Boss-sized silhouette with an imposing presence. Attack windup rears back and gathers strength; attack contact strikes forward hard with a clearly different pose; death lies collapsed flat. Distinct from humanoid swordsmen and from the style reference subject.
